instruction: Perform the brownfield security review for a docs-only change. Review only the touched README.md and .gitignore content for PII, secrets, credential leakage, unsafe examples, and misleading security claims. Treat dependency audit findings as pre-existing unless caused by these edits. Do not pass checks lacking evidence; list them under Could not verify. Return a Markdown report in content with Findings, Could not verify, and pre-existing context.

inputs.content: Changed content: ## Board features; one bullet says filter chips narrow the board using active removable chips for status, priority, assignee, due date, and labels, with clear-all. No examples, PII, secrets, credentials, URLs, or security claims were added.
inputs.reason: Complete README content changed by this run
